_comment: Per-feature LLM endpoint configuration for uai_toolkit.
Copy to $AI_ROOT/config/llm_endpoints.json and edit, or point AI_LLM_ENDPOINTS at it.
NOTHING is configured by default: any feature you leave out (or leave with an empty
endpoints list) is simply disabled and makes no network connection.
Each feature is INDEPENDENT — give each one whichever model suits it.
Endpoints within a feature are tried IN ORDER, so you can put a local model first
and a hosted one as fallback.
Endpoint fields:
name         label for logs
kind         'openai'    -> POST {base_url}/v1/chat/completions
(local LLLM, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, ...)
'anthropic' -> POST {base_url}/v1/messages
base_url     REQUIRED http(s) destination. Host root or a URL ending in /v1.
URL-embedded credentials, query strings, and fragments are rejected.
model        model id the endpoint expects
api_key_env  NAME OF AN ENV VAR holding the credential (never the key itself).
Omit for a local server that needs no auth.
timeout      seconds (default 15)
max_tokens   response cap (default 500)
enabled      set false to switch one endpoint off without deleting it
extra_body   optional dict for server-specific knobs; cannot replace prompt/model/token fields
The HTTP transport is optional: install uai-toolkit[full] to provide httpx.

quality_gate._doc: Reviews an assistant response at end of turn. Sends prompt+response text.

intent_check._doc: Checks whether a turn stated an intent but took no action.

session_assess._doc: Structured per-session assessment feeding the work landscape.

consolidation_summary._doc: Summarizes a turn-range during context consolidation.

mcp_prompt._doc: Reserved for a future prompt-only MCP tool; no shipped consumer yet.
